# Basic Incident Command System for Initial Response (ICS 200) Training

> 4-hour online course for supervisors and leaders on using the Incident Command System as incidents expand. Aligned with FEMA IS-200 and the National Incident Management System (NIMS). Builds on ICS 100. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Alignment: FEMA IS-200 (Basic Incident Command System for Initial Response); NIMS
- Prerequisite: ICS 100, Introduction to the Incident Command System
- Duration: about 4 hours; 3 modules, 9 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.4 CEU
- Price: $79.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Other formats: SCORM, virtual instructor-led, in-person
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 36 months
- Renewal: FEMA sets no fixed frequency; best practice is at least every three years

## Topics beyond ICS 100
Command and General Staff activation in expanding incidents; transfer of command; unified command and Area Command; delegation of authority; management by objectives; resource management and incident typing (Type 3 and Type 4).

## Who it is for
Firefighters, police and EMTs; public health workers; emergency management and homeland security staff; military and National Guard; public works and utilities; Incident Management Team members; private-sector and NGO representatives; facility safety officers and school or hospital administrators.

## Modules
1. Foundation of NIMS and ICS (lessons 1–3)
2. Organizational Structure and Functional Roles (lessons 4–6)
3. Resource Management and Applied Practice (lessons 7–9, including two practical scenarios)
